reviewNotes: Reviewed all 136 exported speech keys against all 20 source cards and explicit furigana in data/pages47-49-craft.json. Checked contextual topic は → わ, directional へ → え, object を → お. Preserved lexical はもの, はがね, はさき, はもち, はめん, はつけ, はってん, はんばい, はこ, はいり and はんだん; lexical なは, はっこう and すいはん retained. Checked さかい, せき, えちぜん, つばめさんじょう, ちよづるくにやす, ふちゅう, たんせつ, なかご, とんや and all maker names against source readings; retained source 恒一 reading こうのすけ. PDF rendered ぴーでぃーえふ; loanwords converted to hiragana preserving long vowels. Arrows and equals sign rendered as pauses; terminal punctuation supplied. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
